b_side_relief.solder_envelope: not needed for clearance: every relief is a through-cut sized from native copper and the sourced body outline

keying.method: B-face features stand proud of the B face: PJ-324M terminals (nominal 1.6 mm, MANUFACTURER_MIRROR) and the soldered R0603 terminations (body up to 0.55 mm, SOURCE_DERIVED). In the correct pose all of them fall into through-cuts; turned 180 degrees in plane, the listed centres land on solid carrier, hold the board off the land and the datum pins, and the probes miss the test pads. Face-down insertion is excluded by the F-side jacks.
keying.acceptance_requirement: trial-insert the board turned 180 degrees: it must not seat (visible gap at the datum pins)

support.method: grid 0.1 mm over the board outline inside the carrier (board X 0-16.2, Y 20.0-62.9)
support.load_path: clamp pins (F side) -> board -> solid carrier land under each pin -> carrier; probe forces push the board against the clamp only within the clamped, supported area
support.scope: geometric layout only; no deflection analysis (the clamp points sit over land, so the board is not loaded in bending between a clamp point and its support)

holddown.rule: pressure pins on the F side, clear of every native F courtyard by 0.3 mm, each over solid carrier land so the clamp load passes straight through the board into the carrier; nothing presses on jack bodies or solder joints
holddown.required_clamp_force_basis: all five probes at the 6.35 mm maximum stroke (graph value); the clamp must exceed it so the board stays on the carrier land at any stroke

registration.datums: board pushed by the clamp/bias against X1, X2 (x = 16.2 edge) and Y1 (y = 62.9 edge); spring bias makes the datum contact clearance zero
registration.allocation_class: PROJECT-CHOICE, each closed by the acceptance measurement below
acceptance_requirements: each board: TP1-TP5 pad centres measured from the x = 16.2 and y = 62.9 edges; radial deviation from the design position <= 0.10 mm, else the board is not tested in this fixture
carrier: bore centres measured from the datum pin contact lines; radial deviation <= 0.05 mm; bores 0.98-1.00 mm; every cut edge within +/-0.05 mm of the design line; walls not below 0.27 mm
installed probes: tip lateral offset from the bore axis at the working stroke <= 0.07 mm

stroke.travel_stop: the board B face seats on the solid carrier land, which is independent of the probe installation height
stroke.set_installation_height: press-ring receptacle pressed to the depth that leaves the probe tip 4.3 mm above the carrier top (recommended working stroke) with the board absent
stroke.acceptance_requirement: each probe: free tip height above the carrier top 4.3 +/-0.3 mm (stroke 4.0-4.6 mm, inside 0-6.35 mm)
stroke.force_basis: linear INGUN force-stroke graph (0.44 N preload, 1.0 N at 4.3 mm)

free_space.below_carrier: every relief is a through-cut, so nothing on the B face touches the carrier; a part longer than the 5 mm carrier continues into the space below it, which the undesigned base must keep free
unsourced: J5 (PicoBlade 530470310): lead tail below the B face: the carrier does not depend on it, the base below the carrier does

Hold-down/bias mechanism not selected (owner/supplier choice): it must press the three listed F-side points with more than 6.35 N in total and bias the board against X1, X2 and Y1; probe guide, base fixing, insulation and wire retention are not designed.
No complete assembly STEP/drawing with an interference check; the carrier STEP alone is not a finished fixture.
Receptacle drawing diameter 0.96mm versus PDF table 0.95mm; use 0.96mm envelope only as conservative study input, resolve before selection.
No physical fit, contact, insertion-force or measured stroke evidence; no prototype exists; the acceptance measurements in b_side_relief are requirements, not results.

Carrier manufacturability not confirmed: the narrowest through-cut is 0.15 mm and every internal corner is sharp, so the process must cut the merged shapes as drawn (or widen the bridges) and hold the 0.27 mm walls; no fabricator is selected and the captured JLCCNC guidance (candidate reference only) is not satisfied.
